purpose: Provide an owner-local deterministic execution surface for existing bounded S30 sandbox regressions so PASE orchestration no longer needs S30 execution logic embedded inside Validate Packs.
ownership_invariants: The runner executes S30 bounded regression tests only.
The runner does not resolve CI applicability or currentness.
The runner does not execute PACK_VALIDATION or pack-local validators.
The runner does not perform Git writes, database writes, Supabase writes, runtime execution, deployment or production activation.
The runner may be invoked by the pass orchestrator after applicability has already been decided.
The historical Validate LF Packs carrier is not an ownership authority for S30 and must not be required by this runner.
